properties.name: freeswitch.esl.password
properties.description: Password used when a server has no server-specific password. Required when a server has no password.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.events
properties.description: FreeSWITCH plain events subscribed after authentication.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.custom-events
properties.description: FreeSWITCH CUSTOM event subclasses subscribed after authentication, such as callcenter::info.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.command-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for an ESL command response.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.connect-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time to wait for a TCP connection.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.reconnect-delay
properties.description: Delay before reconnecting after a connection failure.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.worker-threads
properties.description: Netty worker threads; zero uses the runtime default.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.event-threads
properties.description: Event listener threads; zero uses the runtime default.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.event-queue-capacity
properties.description: Maximum number of received events waiting for listener threads; zero uses the default.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.max-header-line-length
properties.description: Maximum length of one ESL header line in bytes.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.max-frame-length
properties.description: Maximum length of an ESL message body in bytes.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.auto-startup
properties.description: Start ESL connections automatically with the Spring context.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.servers
properties.description: FreeSWITCH ESL servers to connect to.

properties.name: freeswitch.esl.servers[].password
properties.description: Password for this server; empty uses the shared password.
